title: Concept: URL built from a runtime value in java — review required
description: In java, a URL object is created from a variable. The class accepts every scheme it can resolve, and the connection follows redirects by default. SSRF defences belong before construction, because once the URL exists the target has already been chosen.
applicability: java services that fetch remote resources.
risk: Server-side request forgery against internal services; MEDIUM severity.
